description: This is a C# test class for Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically testing delayed queue rebalancing with Azure Queue Streams within an Orleans cluster. It includes configuration, setup, teardown, and test methods using Xunit.

classes.name: DelayedQueueRebalancingTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying delayed queue rebalancing in Orleans streaming with Azure Queue provider, using Xunit as the test framework.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client to use a specific set of gateways.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo builder with Azure Queue stream provider and cluster options.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with Azure Queue streams and silo configurations.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes resources and cleans up Azure queues after tests.

methods.name: DelayedQueueRebalancingTests_1
